c74object.name: void.sm.reader
c74object.digest: Shared memory reader for control-rate numeric data
c74object.description:
void.sm.reader reads control-rate numeric data from a POSIX shared memory segment created by void.sm.writer or void.sm.writer~, following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2).
The shared memory layout starts with a fixed header containing identity, versioning, topology, epoch, and ownership information. This header is immediately followed by a contiguous array of 32-bit floating point values organized as channels by length.
The reader performs a strict snapshot read on each bang or polling tick. The shared memory segment is opened, validated, read, and released on each access. No persistent pointer to the payload is kept across reads.
This object is part of the VOID Shared Memory ecosystem and is designed for robust inter-application communication with explicit validation, reconnection, and layout tracking.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the POSIX shared memory segment to attach to.
This must match the name used by the corresponding writer. The name can also be set or changed using the @name attribute.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to attach to.
Changing this attribute immediately closes any existing mapping. The next read attempt will reopen the shared memory using the new name.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects how numeric data is output.
In values mode, the object outputs one list per channel. Each list starts with the channel index followed by all values for that channel.
In list mode, the object outputs a single flat list containing all values in memory order, corresponding to channels multiplied by length.

attribute.name: poll
attribute.description:
Enables or disables automatic polling using an internal Max clock.
When enabled, the reader periodically performs a full snapshot read of the shared memory at the rate defined by poll_freq.

attribute.name: poll_freq
attribute.description:
Frequency, in Hertz, at which polling occurs when enabled.
The polling interval is computed as one thousand divided by poll_freq and expressed in milliseconds.

inlet.description:
Accepts control messages.
The bang message performs a single snapshot read of the shared memory.
The poll 0 or poll 1 message disables or enables automatic polling.
The getWriterInfo message outputs ownership information stored in the shared memory header.

outlet.description:
Outputs numeric data read from shared memory.
In values mode, one list is output per channel, beginning with the channel index.
In list mode, a single flat list containing all values is output.

Outputs status and informational messages.
The connected message indicates that a valid shared memory segment has been successfully read.
The disconnected message indicates that the shared memory could not be opened or failed validation.
The writerinfo message is followed by three symbols specifying the writer application, project, and node identifiers stored in the shared memory header.
